title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

About the Role

VIAS is looking for a Growth Marketing Specialist to help drive pipeline growth across key Business Units by turning strategy into high-impact execution.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional marketing role for someone who can translate technical solutions into compelling campaigns, content, and digital experiences that generate demand. You will work across multiple channels and initiatives, including email, social media, landing pages, webinars, events, outbound support, and performance tracking.

You will also be expected to use AI tools confidently and practically to improve the speed, quality, and scale of marketing execution. We are looking for a marketer who combines strong execution skills with commercial thinking, digital fluency, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across different parts of the business.




Role Objective

Drive pipeline growth by translating technical solutions into high-performing marketing programs across assigned Business Units. This role connects strategy to execution across campaigns, content, events, digital channels, and reporting, ensuring marketing initiatives are aligned to revenue goals and delivered effectively.




Key Responsibilities

Demand Generation and Campaign Execution

Execute marketing campaigns across assigned Business Units, ensuring strategy is translated into coordinated, multi-channel execution. Support campaign planning, manage timelines, and ensure campaigns launch on time with consistent messaging across all channels.

Help deploy and optimize campaigns across email marketing, social media, web and landing pages, outbound sequences, webinars, and event follow-up. Coordinate with internal stakeholders from each Business Unit to align priorities, messaging, launches, and deadlines.




Content Development and Channel Adaptation

Create, adapt, and repurpose content for different formats and channels, ensuring technical solutions are communicated clearly and effectively to the right audiences.

Develop content for email campaigns, LinkedIn and other social channels, landing pages, website content, webinars, and outbound support. Adapt messaging appropriately for each channel while maintaining consistency with campaign objectives and brand positioning.

Work with external design and video partners to brief, coordinate, and deliver campaign assets.




Webinar, Event, and Content Series Support

Support the planning and execution of strategic marketing initiatives such as webinars, industry events, customer events, podcast episodes, and technical content series.

Coordinate timelines, materials, logistics, follow-up communications, and content distribution to ensure these initiatives contribute to lead generation and pipeline development. Help connect each initiative to the wider campaign flow, including promotion, registration, follow-up, nurturing, and post-event repurposing.




Podcast and Repurposed Content Execution

Support the production and promotion of podcast episodes and technical content series, including scheduling, content preparation, and post-launch distribution.




Turn long-form content into a consistent stream of campaign assets, including social posts, email content, blog content, landing page copy, and outbound support messaging, maximizing content value across channels.




CRM, Attribution, and Performance Support

Support the accuracy and effectiveness of campaign tracking and marketing reporting by helping maintain clean data and strong attribution practices across CRM and campaign platforms.




Help maintain CRM data accuracy in Zoho, ensure correct campaign attribution, support lead tracking and reporting, and build simple dashboards or reporting views to monitor campaign performance. Analyze results and identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, conversion rates, and overall campaign effectiveness.




Lead Scoring, Segmentation, and Intent Data Support

Support the refinement of lead scoring and segmentation practices by working with Marketing and Sales to improve lead quality and campaign relevance.

Help align MQL criteria with Sales, analyze engagement behavior, and use tools to improve targeting, sequencing, and prioritization based on intent and engagement.




AI-Enabled Marketing Execution

Use AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of marketing execution across content creation, campaign ideation, research, segmentation, reporting, and workflow efficiency.




Apply AI to repurpose technical content, support message testing, accelerate research and summarization, improve campaign productivity, and identify opportunities for smarter automation across the marketing function. Use good judgment to ensure outputs remain accurate, relevant, and aligned with brand and business goals.




What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently turning strategy into execution across multiple Business Units, keeping campaigns and content moving, and helping Marketing contribute more effectively to pipeline growth.

A strong performer in this role will launch campaigns on time, deliver high-quality content across channels, improve the connection between campaigns, events, and follow-up, contribute to better reporting and attribution discipline, and use AI to increase productivity without compromising quality.




KPIs

Performance in this role will be measured through a combination of business impact and execution quality, including pipeline contribution, campaign delivery, content output, conversion performance, event and webinar contribution, and CRM/reporting accuracy.

Key measures include marketing-sourced pipeline, marketing-influenced pipeline, campaign launch timeliness, number of campaigns executed across assigned Business Units, content pieces delivered per campaign, social media consistency aligned to campaign activity, lead-to-MQL conversion, MQL-to-SQL conversion, landing page conversion rates, leads generated from webinars and events, post-event follow-up performance, attribution accuracy, and reporting completeness.




Required Experience and Skills

We are looking for a marketer with a strong mix of execution, content development, campaign coordination, commercial thinking, and digital fluency.

You should bring experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or campaign execution. You should be comfortable creating and adapting content across email, social, web, and event-related formats, and confident managing campaigns from planning through launch and follow-up.




You should also have experience working across multiple stakeholders and priorities, familiarity with CRM and campaign reporting tools, and strong organizational skills with close attention to detail. An analytical mindset is important, along with the ability to interpret campaign results and identify improvement opportunities.

Practical experience using AI tools to improve marketing execution, content production, research, segmentation, and performance analysis is required.

Experience with platforms such as Mailchimp, Zoho, LinkedIn, IA for lead generation and ZoomInfo will be a strong advantage.




Preferred Background

Experience in technical, engineering, industrial, software, or solutions-based B2B environments would be highly valued. Experience supporting webinars, events, podcasts, or technical content series is also a plus.

Candidates who thrive in lean, fast-moving environments and are comfortable taking ownership across a broad marketing scope will be especially well suited to this role.




Who You Are

You are a proactive marketer who knows how to make things happen. You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution and can keep multiple projects moving without losing attention to detail. You are commercially minded, organized, curious, data-aware, and confident working with technical subject matter.

You are also comfortable using AI as a practical tool to improve how marketing gets done. You do not wait for perfect conditions to execute. You bring structure, momentum, and ownership.




Additional Requirements:

Must be based in Mexico

Valid visa required for occasional travel to the United States and Canada

100% proficiency in English (written and reading comprehension required)

Why Join VIAS

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in a marketing team that is closely connected to business growth. You will work across multiple Business Units, contribute directly to pipeline development, and help shape how modern marketing execution scales through better processes, stronger content, smarter campaigns, and effective use of AI.




If you are looking for a role where you can combine campaigns, content, digital execution, performance awareness, and business impact in a hands-on B2B environment, this role offers real scope and visibility.

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

• Atención al detalle.

title: Gerente de Marketing de Crecimiento
description:
About the job

88 BRANDS

Growth Marketing Manager

Marca DTC · Presencial en Guadalajara

Estrategia, performance y creativo — dueño del motor de adquisición de punta a punta




Sobre el rol

Estamos construyendo el motor de adquisición de una marca de consumo directo al consumidor (DTC) y buscamos a la persona que lo lidere de punta a punta. Este no es un rol de un solo carril: buscamos a alguien que piense la estrategia, dirija el creativo y opere la pauta — no un ejecutor que solo prende y apaga campañas.

Es un rol fundacional y de amplio espectro. La persona ideal es un “todólogo” de marketing con base sólida en performance: cómodo saltando de la estrategia al análisis de datos, del brief creativo a la optimización de una campaña, con criterio propio y ganas de construir desde cero. Sus decisiones se medirán directo en ventas.

Responsabilidades

• Definir la estrategia de crecimiento y adquisición de la marca: qué canales, qué audiencias, qué mensajes y cómo se conectan entre sí.

• Conceptualizar y dirigir la estrategia creativa: definir ángulos, hooks, narrativas y formatos de anuncio, y guiar al equipo creativo (interno o freelance) en su producción.

• Conectar y mantener la infraestructura de tracking: integrar Shopify con Meta (Pixel + Conversions API) y Google Ads, asegurando atribución limpia y datos confiables.

• Planear, lanzar y optimizar campañas de paid en Meta y Google con foco en ROAS, CPA y CAC.

• Gestionar el presupuesto de medios y escalarlo de forma rentable conforme la marca crece.

• Diseñar y correr experimentos (A/B testing de creativos, audiencias, landing pages) y traducir los resultados en decisiones.

• Monitorear métricas diarias, reportar aprendizajes accionables y ajustar en consecuencia.

Lo que buscamos

• Experiencia comprobable manejando campañas de paid en Meta y Google Ads con presupuesto real (no solo cursos o cuentas personales).

• Dominio de la integración Shopify ↔ Meta ↔ Google: Pixel, CAPI, catálogos, eventos de conversión.

• Ojo creativo y estratégico: capacidad de conceptualizar campañas y dirigir el creativo, no solo ejecutar pauta.

• Mentalidad de performance: piensa en ROAS y CAC, no en likes.

• Perfil amplio y autónomo: cómodo cubriendo estrategia, creativo, pauta y análisis, con ganas de construir desde cero.

Suma puntos

• Experiencia previa en e-commerce o DTC.

• Familiaridad con herramientas de análisis (GA4, hojas de cálculo a nivel intermedio-avanzado).

Lo que ofrecemos

• Sueldo base de hasta $30,000 MXN mensuales más bonos por resultados atados a métricas de desempeño (ROAS, ventas, CAC): tu impacto se refleja directo en tu ingreso.

• Un rol con voz real en la estrategia y libertad para construir el área a tu manera.

• Trabajar de cerca con la fundación de la marca, sin capas de burocracia.

• Modalidad presencial en Guadalajara.

Proceso de aplicación

Si te interesa, escríbenos con una breve nota respondiendo tres cosas:

• El presupuesto mensual más alto que has manejado en Meta y el ROAS/CPA que lograste sostener.

• Las categorías o tipos de producto que has escalado.

• Un caso concreto donde tu estrategia movió la aguja, con números.

Con eso avanzamos a una conversación donde compartimos el detalle del proyecto.

88brands · Guadalajara, Jalisco

description:
About the job

Location: Mexico (preferred) | Hybrid / Remote




About Sarelly




Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand—we're building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company designed for the next generation of Latina consumers.

As we expand into the U.S., we're investing in a new capability: an AI-powered Consumer Intelligence Hub that continuously transforms consumer signals into better business decisions.

Rather than relying on traditional research, we're building a proprietary intelligence system that combines first-party data, social conversations, creator communities, AI and strategic thinking to guide Product, Brand, Growth and Retail.

We're looking for someone to lead that capability.




The Opportunity




This is not a traditional Consumer & Market Insights role.

You won't spend your time commissioning surveys and writing research reports.

Instead, you'll build and own Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence function, working at the intersection of consumer understanding, AI and business strategy.

Your mission is simple: Turn consumer signals into better business decisions.

Working alongside an external AI Intelligence Architect and the executive team, you'll help build one of the first AI-native Consumer Intelligence capabilities in beauty.




Key Responsibilities




Build Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence Framework




Define and continuously refine Sarelly's proprietary consumer taxonomy.
Organize consumer signals around business questions rather than platforms.
Ensure our AI systems are trained to identify meaningful consumer patterns instead of simply reporting data.
Continuously improve the quality and relevance of our intelligence model.










Define the AI Intelligence Architect




You'll lead the building of the technical infrastructure: 

Define how raw consumer data should be categorized and tagged.
Brief AI workflows and prompting frameworks.
Validate AI outputs
Identify new data sources that should be integrated into the system.










Translate Intelligence into Business Recommendations




You'll synthesize consumer intelligence into executive recommendations.

Your recommendations will directly influence:

Product Innovation
Franchise Development
Marketing
Creator Strategy
CRM
Retail










What Success Looks Like




Identify emerging consumer needs before competitors.
Translate consumer language into stronger messaging.
Identify product innovation opportunities earlier.
Improve creator selection and content strategy.
Make faster, evidence-based business decisions.










Become the Internal Expert on Latina Consumers




Help Sarelly develop the deepest understanding of Latina beauty consumers in the industry.

This includes understanding differences across:

Cultural identities
Heritage groups
Beauty routines
Consumer language
Shopping behaviors
Generations
Geographic markets
Emerging cultural trends

Rather than treating the Latina consumer as one audience, you'll help us understand the nuances that drive relevance.




Build a Learning Organization




Champion a culture of curiosity across the company. Help teams move from reporting observations to generating insights and making better business decisions.




Required Experience




2-3 

years in Consumer Insights, Innovation.
Experience working with multicultural or diverse consumer audiences.
Strong qualitative and strategic thinking skills.
Experience translating consumer research into business recommendations.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills.
Fluent in English and Spanish.










Preferred Experience




Strong preference for candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

Beauty or personal care
Consumer packaged goods
Creator economy
Community-led brands
Consumer innovation
Consumer segmentation
U.S. Hispanic / Latina consumers
Mexican and U.S. markets

Experience across different Latina sub-communities and target demographics is highly valued.




AI Requirements (Must Have)




We are intentionally building an AI-native Consumer Intelligence function.

You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be highly AI-literate.

You should be comfortable:

Working daily with Claude, ChatGPT or similar AI tools.
Developing prompts and AI workflows.
Validating AI-generated insights.
Using AI to accelerate research and synthesis.
Rethinking traditional research methods through AI rather than simply replicating existing processes.

Curiosity about AI and willingness to experiment are essential.




Skills




Consumer research
Strategic thinking
Hypothesis generation
Pattern recognition
Cultural analysis
Storytelling
AI literacy
Project management
Cross-functional collaboration










Mindset




We're looking for someone who:

Is endlessly curious about people.
Naturally connects dots that others miss.
Questions assumptions before accepting them.
Loves experimenting with AI.
Enjoys building systems, not just reports.
Thinks like a strategist, not only a researcher.
Wants to help build a capability that doesn't yet exist.










Why Join Sarelly?




This is a rare opportunity to build the Consumer Intelligence function from the ground up.

Rather than inheriting traditional research processes, you'll help define how AI and human judgment work together to create a structural competitive advantage for one of the most culturally relevant beauty brands in the market.

description:
About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across voice, email, and enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z and Base10 with over $60M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments - where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

As a Deployment Strategist, your mission is to connect the dots between user needs, data insights, and product capabilities to help our customers unlock value. You’ll dive deep into our customer operations, partner directly with end users and decision-makers, and shape how HappyRobot’s technology is applied to their most critical challenges.

At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You Will Do


Partnering with customers to understand their workflows, goals, and pain points—often embedding directly with their teams.
Collaborating with Forward Deployment Engineers to scope, prototype, and deliver solutions powered by HappyRobot’s platform.
Identifying and interpreting key datasets that drive customer decision-making, and working to integrate them into robust, scalable pipelines.
Designing and refining user workflows that solve meaningful problems and scale across teams and functions.
Leading training and onboarding sessions, ensuring new users are set up for success and our tools have lasting impact.
Presenting findings and strategy to stakeholders at all levels—from frontline operators to executives.
Driving customer expansion by scoping new use cases and shaping how we grow our footprint within organizations.


Why join us?


Opportunity to work at a high-growth AI startup, backed by top investors.
Rapidly growing and backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, and Base10.
Ownership & Autonomy - Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
Comprehensive Benefits - Healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Top-Tier Compensation - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.
Work With the Best - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

About Smart Capital Center

 

Smart Capital Center is an AI-powered platform built for Commercial Real Estate (CRE) investment and financial management in the U.S. market.

 

Our platform combines real-time data intelligence, workflow automation, and AI-driven insights to support underwriting, asset management, and portfolio analytics for institutional real estate firms.

As we continue growing, we are looking for a highly capable Marketing Specialist to help expand our digital presence, strengthen brand visibility, and support content and growth initiatives across multiple channels.




The Opportunity

This is a hands-on marketing role for someone who is highly organized, tech-savvy, creative, and excited to work in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

 

You will work closely with leadership and operations teams to execute digital marketing initiatives, manage content workflows, improve online visibility, and support the company’s growth strategy.

 

This role is ideal for candidates who learn quickly, enjoy working with modern AI tools, and want to build real-world experience in technology-driven marketing operations.

About the job

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is looking for a detail oriented and experienced specialist to join our evolving Trust and Safety team. This individual will review a broad variety of Safety concerns and will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing a safe and happy global community of Lyft’s drivers and riders. We're looking for someone motivated to go above and beyond for our community members to instill trust in the Lyft platform. Join us to create, implement and expand our community's safety practices.

The successful candidate will demonstrate an expert level understanding of egregious circumstances, empathetic communication, and will use their specialized skill set to review safety incidents with the goal of helping to mitigate the negative impact for the reporting victims and ultimately remove those that violate our Terms of Service and Community Guidelines from the platform. Ideal candidates will be passionate about working with the team to build a world-class safety organization; they consistently hold themselves and others accountable, keeping focus on their team’s overall goals and putting others before themselves.. They will be passionate about identifying policy and helping to create a platform to provide the best end to end experience for the riders and drivers in our community, especially when related to decision making due to safety-related incidents.

Responsibilities:


Exemplify customer obsession by strong safety advocate for our community while providing fair resolutions to customers problems
Utilize cross functional communication and relationships to drive the best outcome for the customer and Lyft 
Be accountable to key performance metrics set for the team such as SLAs, quality measures, and decision timelines

About the job

Our mission is to open the door to the life-changing impact of education. We build market-leading, online college credit and test-preparation solutions that help working adults earn their degrees, advance their careers, and achieve economic mobility. Recognized by Fast Company and GSV 150 as one of the world’s most innovative education companies, we are also at the forefront of AI-first learning, combining artificial intelligence with the latest learning science to improve access and outcomes at scale.




Our product is our impact. Through our Keys to College and Keys to the Classroom initiatives, we have saved students over $700 million in tuition and enabled hundreds of thousands of learners to pursue and succeed in careers across nursing, teaching, counseling, business, and other high-demand fields. We are deeply focused on measurable outcomes and building products that create meaningful, lasting change in people’s lives.




Role Overview

We are seeking a strategic, research-driven Content Specialist, Content Marketing to join our team. This role is crucial in researching, planning, and producing content that earns high-quality backlinks, co-citations (being cited alongside trusted entities), and high-quality brand mentions (linked and unlinked) from authoritative websites and publications. The specialist will be familiar with trends and hot topics in education, test prep, and career licensure and will identify content ideas that are new and interesting to prospective linkers, journalists, and industry publishers.




The ideal candidate has strong SEO instincts, editorial judgment, and the ability to translate trends, data, and SME insight into outreach-ready content that publishers want to reference.




Additionally, we are looking for someone proactive, collaborative, and AI-driven, someone who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment and uses AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and content production without compromising quality.

Research and plan content that engages target audiences and earns links, mentions, and co-citations from authoritative sources.
Identify trends, audience interests, and publisher opportunities across education, test prep, and career licensure.

Manage the end-to-end content production process, including sourcing SMEs, writers, and reviewers while maintaining quality and deadlines.

Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, trend discovery, ideation, drafting, and QA

Collaborative mindset and comfort working cross-functionally with outreach and production teams.
Analytical thinking: ability to find, interpret, and frame insights into compelling narratives.
Familiarity with AI tools and other tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Canva (or similar).

Excellent written and spoken English language skills

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to support our Fintech line of business in Mexico. This role is critical in enabling localized insights and supporting operational execution through data. You will partner closely with regional team of Engagement to help drive key initiatives that serve our customers in Mexico.

In this role, you'll be...


Participate in business analysis efforts for Mexico’s credit card product
Translate local market dynamics into actionable insights by analyzing customer behavior, product performance, and financial metrics.
Collaborate with stakeholders in the credit card Engagement Operation team to support go-to-market strategies, product enhancements, and regulatory initiatives
Monitor and report on key business metrics through dashboards and performance reviews tailored to the Mexican market.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency by aligning with data engineering and governance teams.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, or related field.
1+ years of experience in business analysis or analytics, preferably in fintech or financial services.
Solid command of SQL and Python, along with a proactive attitude toward learning new technologies and coding languages as needed.
Experience in product performance tracking, financial modeling, and decision support is preferred
Fluency in English.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About the job

Commercial Landscaping Business | Remote via ScaleSource | Bilingual English/Spanish


Do you think you are a fit for this role but decided not to apply? Please tell us why.

About Us

We are a growing commercial landscaping company serving property managers, HOAs, multifamily communities, retail centers, office parks, business owners, and other commercial clients.

Yes, we mow grass, clean beds, trim shrubs, fix irrigation, handle seasonal color, and keep properties looking sharp.

But the real business we are in is trust.

Our clients are busy. They do not want to babysit their landscaping company. They do not want to send the same email three times. They do not want vague updates. They do not want “let me check on that” followed by silence.

They want someone who owns the issue, communicates clearly, follows through, and makes their life easier.

That is what this role is for.

We are hiring a Client Success / Customer Experience Lead who can help us build a client experience that is way better than what most local service businesses deliver.

This is a remote role through ScaleSource, but this is not a low-level assistant role. This is a leadership-level communication, execution, and follow-up seat.

You will be expected to think, lead, solve, track, follow up, and make sure things actually get done.

If you need to be told every step, this is not the role.

If you see problems, organize chaos, chase answers, communicate clearly, and make sure the ball does not get dropped, you may be exactly who we need.

The Big Picture

Our Standard Is Simple:

No client should ever have to wonder where something stands.

If a client has a question, complaint, issue, request, project update, scheduling concern, irrigation problem, billing question, or property concern, we need that item captured, clarified, assigned, tracked, updated, and completed.

Our goal is that most client issues or requests are resolved within 72 hours or less.

Next day is better.

Same day is beautiful.

But even when something cannot be solved immediately, the client should still receive clear, honest, proactive updates so they know we are on it.

We do not need someone who says, “I passed the message along.”

We Need Someone Who Says:

“I found the issue, confirmed who owns it, tracked the next step, updated the client, followed up with operations, and confirmed it was completed.”

That is the difference.

Role Mission

Your mission is to help us deliver world-class communication and client experience in a business where things move fast, weather changes plans, crews are in the field, clients have urgent needs, and details can easily get lost.

You will be the person helping make sure they do not get lost.

You will work between clients, field leadership, operations, admin, and ownership to make sure communication is clear and execution is tracked.

You are not just answering emails.

You are helping lead the customer experience.

What You’ll Own1. Client Communication

You will communicate with commercial clients through email, phone, text, client portals, CRM systems, video updates, and virtual meetings.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Responding to client messages quickly and professionally
Sending clear updates before clients have to chase us
Explaining what happened, what we are doing, who is responsible, and when the next update will happen
Communicating delays, weather issues, scheduling changes, property concerns, and service updates
Making clients feel heard without overpromising nonsense we cannot deliver
Keeping communication honest, calm, warm, and professional
Making us feel like the most organized landscaping company they have ever worked with


The goal is not to sound fancy.

The goal is to be clear, useful, trustworthy, and fast.


 Issue Ownership and 72-Hour Follow-Through


When a client reports an issue, you do not just forward it and hope someone handles it.

You own the communication loop until the item is completed.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Capturing the issue clearly
Asking good questions when the request is vague
Confirming property, location, priority, photos, timing, and client expectation
Assigning or escalating the issue to the correct internal person
Tracking the status until completion
Following up with operations or field leadership
Updating the client proactively
Confirming completion with notes, photos, or internal confirmation when possible
Closing the loop so everyone knows the issue was handled


Our standard is that client asks and issues should be completed or clearly moved forward within 72 hours whenever possible.

If something will take longer, the client still gets a real update.

No disappearing.

No vague “checking on it.”

No black holes.


 Problem Identification and Solutions


This role requires leadership judgment.

You should be able to identify patterns and problems before they become bigger problems.

For Example:


A client keeps asking about the same issue
A property keeps having the same service complaint
A crew keeps missing the same detail
A work order is stuck with no update
A client has not heard from us in too long
A property manager seems frustrated even if they are being polite
A process is clearly broken and causing repeat confusion


Your job is not just to report problems.

Your job is to help create solutions.

You Should Be Able To Say:

“Here is the issue I am seeing. Here is the pattern. Here is what I recommend we do. Here is who needs to own it. Here is how I will track it.”

That is the level we need.


 Execution Tracking


You will help make sure the company has a clean system for tracking client requests, property issues, service updates, and internal follow-up.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Creating and updating tasks
Keeping CRM/client records clean
Tracking open issues by client/property
Maintaining follow-up dates and deadlines
Confirming completion instead of assuming completion
Helping leadership see what is open, stuck, urgent, or recurring
Preparing simple weekly reports on client issues, aging items, completed items, and recurring concerns
Making sure communication does not live only in someone’s memory, text thread, or random notebook


This role exists because “I think someone is handling it” is how businesses stay mediocre.

We are not doing that.


 Video Updates and Client Meetings


You must be comfortable on video.

This Role May Include:


Recording short Loom-style client updates
Showing your face on camera while explaining an update
Sharing your screen to walk through photos, notes, schedules, open items, or reports
Joining virtual meetings with clients
Joining internal team meetings
Helping create a more human, clear, and professional client experience


You do not need to be a news anchor.

Actually, please do not be a news anchor.

You need to be clear, confident, real, and professional.

Clients should feel like there is a smart human being paying attention.


 Bilingual Team Communication


This role requires strong English and Spanish.

You will often need to help communication flow between English-speaking clients or managers and Spanish-speaking field team members.

You Must Be Able To:


Write excellent English emails and updates
Speak clearly and professionally in English
Communicate effectively in Spanish
Clarify details between team members
Translate or summarize information accurately when needed
Avoid confusion caused by vague communication


Your English needs to be client-ready. Not “pretty good.” Not “I can get by.”

Client-ready.

Our Core Values and Mindset

We care a lot about fit. Skills matter, but mindset matters more.


 FITFO — Figure It The Freak Out


We need people who can think.

You will not always have perfect instructions. That is real life.

When something is unclear, we expect you to ask smart questions, look for context, make a recommendation, and keep moving.

Not panic.

Not disappear.

Not wait three days for someone to spoon-feed the answer.

Figure it out.


 Own It


Ownership means the problem does not have to be your fault for it to become your responsibility.

If a client issue lands with you, you own the communication loop until it is closed.

You do not get to say, “I sent it to operations” and wash your hands of it.

You follow up. You track. You confirm. You close the loop.


 Communicate Early and Honestly


Bad news early is useful.

Bad news late is expensive.

We do not need perfect updates. We need honest updates.

If something is delayed, say it clearly. If we made a mistake, communicate professionally. If you do not know yet, say what you are doing to find out and when the next update will happen.

Clients can handle issues.

They hate silence.


 No Dropped Balls


This role is for someone who hates loose ends.

You should be the kind of person who gets mildly annoyed when tasks are floating around with no owner, no due date, and no follow-up plan.

That annoyance is useful here.


 Calm Is a Superpower


Commercial landscaping can get messy.

Weather happens. Crews run late. Clients get frustrated. Irrigation breaks. Properties get missed. Someone forgets to send photos. A manager needs an answer now.

We need someone who stays calm, clear, and useful.

Drama does not help. Ownership does.


 Make the Company Better


We are not hiring you to maintain broken systems.

We are hiring you to help improve them.

If you see a better way to track issues, communicate updates, organize client notes, or prevent repeat problems, speak up and help build it.

What Success Looks Like

You Are Winning In This Role If:


Clients feel informed, respected, and taken care of
Client requests are usually resolved or meaningfully advanced within 72 hours
Open issues are tracked clearly with owners, due dates, and next steps
Clients receive proactive updates before they have to ask
Operations knows exactly what clients need and what is urgent
Recurring client issues are identified and escalated
Leadership can quickly see what is open, stuck, completed, or becoming a pattern
Client communication feels organized, human, and professional
Nothing important gets lost in email, text, WhatsApp, CRM notes, or someone’s brain
You make the business feel calmer, cleaner, and more accountable


Required Qualifications

Please do not apply unless you meet these requirements.


5+ years of customer service, client success, account management, operations coordination, executive assistant, or client-facing admin experience
3+ years working directly with U.S.-based clients or U.S.-based companies
2+ years working remotely in a role that required independent ownership and follow-up
Fluent written and spoken English at a professional, client-facing level
Fluent or highly advanced Spanish communication skills
Proven experience managing 50+ client/customer interactions, tickets, tasks, or follow-up items per week
Proven experience tracking issues through a CRM, help desk, project management tool, spreadsheet, or similar system
Ability to write clear client-facing updates with strong grammar, structure, and tone
Comfortable recording video updates with yourself on camera
Comfortable joining virtual client meetings
Comfortable making phone calls or voice calls when needed
Strong organization skills with a real personal system for tracking work
Strong ability to identify problems, recommend solutions, and follow through
Must be available during core U.S. business hours


Preferred Qualifications

These are not all required, but they are a big plus.


Experience in landscaping, construction, property management, home services, trades, field services, facilities management, or another service business
Experience supporting commercial clients or property managers
Experience with work orders, service tickets, scheduling, estimates, invoicing, or job tracking
Experience using Loom or similar video tools
Experience using CRMs, help desk systems, or project management software
Experience creating client reports or leadership updates
Experience working with bilingual field teams
Experience improving a process, not just following one


Tools You May Use

You do not need to know all of these, but you need to be tech-comfortable and able to learn quickly.


Gmail / Google Workspace
Google Sheets
CRM systems
Jobber, Aspire, LMN, Service Autopilot, Yardbook, HubSpot, Monday.com, ClickUp, or similar platforms
Loom or similar video recording tools
Slack, WhatsApp, or other internal messaging tools
Zoom / Google Meet
QuickBooks or other invoicing systems
Client portals or work order systems


If learning a new tool stresses you out, this is probably not your seat.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who:


Loves creating order out of chaos
Takes pride in being the person who actually follows through
Can handle a frustrated client without getting defensive
Knows how to be warm without being fluffy
Knows how to be direct without being rude
Can manage a lot of moving pieces
Notices when something feels off
Is willing to chase an answer until the answer exists
Can lead from a remote seat
Wants to be part of building something much bigger and better than a normal landscaping company


Who This Role Is NOT For

This Role Is Not For Someone Who:


Needs to be told what to do all day
Waits quietly when something is unclear
Gets overwhelmed by multiple open tasks
Avoids difficult conversations
Is uncomfortable on camera
Writes sloppy English
Says “I’ll check on that” and then forgets
Thinks forwarding a message counts as ownership
Does not like systems, tracking, or follow-up
Wants a simple inbox-only customer service job


This is a leadership support role. You will have help, but you must bring brainpower, ownership, and urgency.

How to apply

We know your CV might not be up to date. Send what you have.

You'll be asked a few questions. Specific, numbers-based answers are expected. This helps us filter the best candidates at early stages of the process. If you have the right experience and you put the effort, it will be noticed. Vague answers won't move forward.

A short video submission might be required at the right stage of the process.

Everyone gets a response within 24 business hours.

A bootstrapped B2B SaaS company serving the seasonal pool service industry is looking for a Sales & Customer Success Representative to own its entire front-line customer and warm-sales operation and take day-to-day communication off the founder's plate.

The company is founder-led and lean, with a low-touch, task-focused culture built around autonomy rather than daily oversight. description:
About the job
This job is sourced from a job board. Learn More

This job is open to candidates working remotely from anywhere
Schedule: You must be available during core U.S. business hours, especially mornings and early afternoons when client, field, and operations communication is most active. Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview process
Compensation: 1250 USD/month first 90 days, 1500 USD/month after that. Bonus to be established after 90 day onboarding, bonus range of 8000 USD every 12 months
Commercial Landscaping Business | Remote via ScaleSource | Bilingual English/Spanish


Do you think you are a fit for this role but decided not to apply? Please tell us why.

About Us

We are a growing commercial landscaping company serving property managers, HOAs, multifamily communities, retail centers, office parks, business owners, and other commercial clients.

Yes, we mow grass, clean beds, trim shrubs, fix irrigation, handle seasonal color, and keep properties looking sharp.

But the real business we are in is trust.

Our clients are busy. They do not want to babysit their landscaping company. They do not want to send the same email three times. They do not want vague updates. They do not want “let me check on that” followed by silence.

They want someone who owns the issue, communicates clearly, follows through, and makes their life easier.

That is what this role is for.

We are hiring a Client Success / Customer Experience Lead who can help us build a client experience that is way better than what most local service businesses deliver.

This is a remote role through ScaleSource, but this is not a low-level assistant role. This is a leadership-level communication, execution, and follow-up seat.

You will be expected to think, lead, solve, track, follow up, and make sure things actually get done.

If you need to be told every step, this is not the role.

If you see problems, organize chaos, chase answers, communicate clearly, and make sure the ball does not get dropped, you may be exactly who we need.

The Big Picture

Our Standard Is Simple:

No client should ever have to wonder where something stands.

If a client has a question, complaint, issue, request, project update, scheduling concern, irrigation problem, billing question, or property concern, we need that item captured, clarified, assigned, tracked, updated, and completed.

Our goal is that most client issues or requests are resolved within 72 hours or less.

Next day is better.

Same day is beautiful.

But even when something cannot be solved immediately, the client should still receive clear, honest, proactive updates so they know we are on it.

We do not need someone who says, “I passed the message along.”

We Need Someone Who Says:

“I found the issue, confirmed who owns it, tracked the next step, updated the client, followed up with operations, and confirmed it was completed.”

That is the difference.

Role Mission

Your mission is to help us deliver world-class communication and client experience in a business where things move fast, weather changes plans, crews are in the field, clients have urgent needs, and details can easily get lost.

You will be the person helping make sure they do not get lost.

You will work between clients, field leadership, operations, admin, and ownership to make sure communication is clear and execution is tracked.

You are not just answering emails.

You are helping lead the customer experience.

What You’ll Own1. Client Communication

You will communicate with commercial clients through email, phone, text, client portals, CRM systems, video updates, and virtual meetings.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Responding to client messages quickly and professionally
Sending clear updates before clients have to chase us
Explaining what happened, what we are doing, who is responsible, and when the next update will happen
Communicating delays, weather issues, scheduling changes, property concerns, and service updates
Making clients feel heard without overpromising nonsense we cannot deliver
Keeping communication honest, calm, warm, and professional
Making us feel like the most organized landscaping company they have ever worked with


The goal is not to sound fancy.

The goal is to be clear, useful, trustworthy, and fast.


 Issue Ownership and 72-Hour Follow-Through


When a client reports an issue, you do not just forward it and hope someone handles it.

You own the communication loop until the item is completed.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Capturing the issue clearly
Asking good questions when the request is vague
Confirming property, location, priority, photos, timing, and client expectation
Assigning or escalating the issue to the correct internal person
Tracking the status until completion
Following up with operations or field leadership
Updating the client proactively
Confirming completion with notes, photos, or internal confirmation when possible
Closing the loop so everyone knows the issue was handled


Our standard is that client asks and issues should be completed or clearly moved forward within 72 hours whenever possible.

If something will take longer, the client still gets a real update.

No disappearing.

No vague “checking on it.”

No black holes.


 Problem Identification and Solutions


This role requires leadership judgment.

You should be able to identify patterns and problems before they become bigger problems.

For Example:


A client keeps asking about the same issue
A property keeps having the same service complaint
A crew keeps missing the same detail
A work order is stuck with no update
A client has not heard from us in too long
A property manager seems frustrated even if they are being polite
A process is clearly broken and causing repeat confusion


Your job is not just to report problems.

Your job is to help create solutions.

You Should Be Able To Say:

“Here is the issue I am seeing. Here is the pattern. Here is what I recommend we do. Here is who needs to own it. Here is how I will track it.”

That is the level we need.


 Execution Tracking


You will help make sure the company has a clean system for tracking client requests, property issues, service updates, and internal follow-up.

You Will Be Responsible For:


Creating and updating tasks
Keeping CRM/client records clean
Tracking open issues by client/property
Maintaining follow-up dates and deadlines
Confirming completion instead of assuming completion
Helping leadership see what is open, stuck, urgent, or recurring
Preparing simple weekly reports on client issues, aging items, completed items, and recurring concerns
Making sure communication does not live only in someone’s memory, text thread, or random notebook


This role exists because “I think someone is handling it” is how businesses stay mediocre.

We are not doing that.


 Video Updates and Client Meetings


You must be comfortable on video.

This Role May Include:


Recording short Loom-style client updates
Showing your face on camera while explaining an update
Sharing your screen to walk through photos, notes, schedules, open items, or reports
Joining virtual meetings with clients
Joining internal team meetings
Helping create a more human, clear, and professional client experience


You do not need to be a news anchor.

Actually, please do not be a news anchor.

You need to be clear, confident, real, and professional.

Clients should feel like there is a smart human being paying attention.


 Bilingual Team Communication


This role requires strong English and Spanish.

You will often need to help communication flow between English-speaking clients or managers and Spanish-speaking field team members.

You Must Be Able To:


Write excellent English emails and updates
Speak clearly and professionally in English
Communicate effectively in Spanish
Clarify details between team members
Translate or summarize information accurately when needed
Avoid confusion caused by vague communication


Your English needs to be client-ready. Not “pretty good.” Not “I can get by.”

Client-ready.

Our Core Values and Mindset

We care a lot about fit. Skills matter, but mindset matters more.


 FITFO — Figure It The Freak Out


We need people who can think.

You will not always have perfect instructions. That is real life.

When something is unclear, we expect you to ask smart questions, look for context, make a recommendation, and keep moving.

Not panic.

Not disappear.

Not wait three days for someone to spoon-feed the answer.

Figure it out.


 Own It


Ownership means the problem does not have to be your fault for it to become your responsibility.

If a client issue lands with you, you own the communication loop until it is closed.

You do not get to say, “I sent it to operations” and wash your hands of it.

You follow up. You track. You confirm. You close the loop.


 Communicate Early and Honestly


Bad news early is useful.

Bad news late is expensive.

We do not need perfect updates. We need honest updates.

If something is delayed, say it clearly. If we made a mistake, communicate professionally. If you do not know yet, say what you are doing to find out and when the next update will happen.

Clients can handle issues.

They hate silence.


 No Dropped Balls


This role is for someone who hates loose ends.

You should be the kind of person who gets mildly annoyed when tasks are floating around with no owner, no due date, and no follow-up plan.

That annoyance is useful here.


 Calm Is a Superpower


Commercial landscaping can get messy.

Weather happens. Crews run late. Clients get frustrated. Irrigation breaks. Properties get missed. Someone forgets to send photos. A manager needs an answer now.

We need someone who stays calm, clear, and useful.

Drama does not help. Ownership does.


 Make the Company Better


We are not hiring you to maintain broken systems.

We are hiring you to help improve them.

If you see a better way to track issues, communicate updates, organize client notes, or prevent repeat problems, speak up and help build it.

What Success Looks Like

You Are Winning In This Role If:


Clients feel informed, respected, and taken care of
Client requests are usually resolved or meaningfully advanced within 72 hours
Open issues are tracked clearly with owners, due dates, and next steps
Clients receive proactive updates before they have to ask
Operations knows exactly what clients need and what is urgent
Recurring client issues are identified and escalated
Leadership can quickly see what is open, stuck, completed, or becoming a pattern
Client communication feels organized, human, and professional
Nothing important gets lost in email, text, WhatsApp, CRM notes, or someone’s brain
You make the business feel calmer, cleaner, and more accountable


Required Qualifications

Please do not apply unless you meet these requirements.


5+ years of customer service, client success, account management, operations coordination, executive assistant, or client-facing admin experience
3+ years working directly with U.S.-based clients or U.S.-based companies
2+ years working remotely in a role that required independent ownership and follow-up
Fluent written and spoken English at a professional, client-facing level
Fluent or highly advanced Spanish communication skills
Proven experience managing 50+ client/customer interactions, tickets, tasks, or follow-up items per week
Proven experience tracking issues through a CRM, help desk, project management tool, spreadsheet, or similar system
Ability to write clear client-facing updates with strong grammar, structure, and tone
Comfortable recording video updates with yourself on camera
Comfortable joining virtual client meetings
Comfortable making phone calls or voice calls when needed
Strong organization skills with a real personal system for tracking work
Strong ability to identify problems, recommend solutions, and follow through
Must be available during core U.S. business hours


Preferred Qualifications

These are not all required, but they are a big plus.


Experience in landscaping, construction, property management, home services, trades, field services, facilities management, or another service business
Experience supporting commercial clients or property managers
Experience with work orders, service tickets, scheduling, estimates, invoicing, or job tracking
Experience using Loom or similar video tools
Experience using CRMs, help desk systems, or project management software
Experience creating client reports or leadership updates
Experience working with bilingual field teams
Experience improving a process, not just following one


Tools You May Use

You do not need to know all of these, but you need to be tech-comfortable and able to learn quickly.


Gmail / Google Workspace
Google Sheets
CRM systems
Jobber, Aspire, LMN, Service Autopilot, Yardbook, HubSpot, Monday.com, ClickUp, or similar platforms
Loom or similar video recording tools
Slack, WhatsApp, or other internal messaging tools
Zoom / Google Meet
QuickBooks or other invoicing systems
Client portals or work order systems


If learning a new tool stresses you out, this is probably not your seat.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who:


Loves creating order out of chaos
Takes pride in being the person who actually follows through
Can handle a frustrated client without getting defensive
Knows how to be warm without being fluffy
Knows how to be direct without being rude
Can manage a lot of moving pieces
Notices when something feels off
Is willing to chase an answer until the answer exists
Can lead from a remote seat
Wants to be part of building something much bigger and better than a normal landscaping company


Who This Role Is NOT For

This Role Is Not For Someone Who:


Needs to be told what to do all day
Waits quietly when something is unclear
Gets overwhelmed by multiple open tasks
Avoids difficult conversations
Is uncomfortable on camera
Writes sloppy English
Says “I’ll check on that” and then forgets
Thinks forwarding a message counts as ownership
Does not like systems, tracking, or follow-up
Wants a simple inbox-only customer service job


This is a leadership support role. You will have help, but you must bring brainpower, ownership, and urgency.

How to apply

We know your CV might not be up to date. Send what you have.

You'll be asked a few questions. Specific, numbers-based answers are expected. This helps us filter the best candidates at early stages of the process. If you have the right experience and you put the effort, it will be noticed. Vague answers won't move forward.

A short video submission might be required at the right stage of the process.

Everyone gets a response within 24 business hours.

description:
About the job

Responsibilities

About the Team

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates.

You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the LATAM. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping.

The TikTok Shop LATAM operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok E-commerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities:


 Take ownership of business development by leading lead mining, conducting in-depth lead validation, and executing strategic seller outreach to drive pipeline growth.
 Conduct analysis of the seller onboarding funnel, identify bottlenecks through data-driven insights, and formulate actionable optimization strategies to improve conversion rates.
 Deeply engage in the design and delivery of seller training programs and support initiatives, including developing campaign frameworks, curating webinar content, and providing personalized guidance to enhance seller performance.
 Plan and execute operational strategies, content roadmaps, and growth initiatives for assigned seller segments, aligning with business objectives to drive scale and engagement.
 Act as a key liaison in meetings with partners, contribute to strategic discussions, and lead cross-team communication to ensure alignment on goals and seamless execution of collaborative projects.
 Analyze and interpret store performance data to identify gaps and opportunities, provide actionable recommendations, and support measurable results.
 Support the development of strategies to grow store sales and identify key actions to improve results.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s):


 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume
 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related major.
 Quick learner, proactive and resilient. Ability to thrive in ambiguity and adjust fast to change.
 Structured thinking, good data sense, very strong analytical skills
 Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration, skilled at moving things forward.
 Passion for business and aim for higher goals.
 Strong learning attitude, positive mindset, and willingness to contribute.


Preferred Qualification(s):


 Familiarity with TikTok content ecosystem, shoppable content, and brand-creator partnerships is a plus


For TikTok

By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. About the job

About Roveia Health

Roveia Health is a specialized growth marketing agency for telehealth, health & wellness, and digital health brands. Founded by alumni from Meta and Tesla, we help companies in the telehealth, supplements, med spa, and patient acquisition space scale through performance-driven advertising and conversion-optimized systems.




We manage millions in monthly ad spend across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn — and we own the retention engine that turns that spend into repeat patients and lifetime value.

Fully remote. Globally distributed. Built to drive real patient and customer growth.




The Role

We're hiring a Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Lead to own email and SMS strategy and execution across a portfolio of telehealth and health & wellness client accounts.




You own the retention engine end to end: you set the email/SMS strategy for new clients, build the lifecycle flows and promotional calendar, write the copy, and brief designers to bring campaigns to life. You're fluent in Customer IO and Omnisend, with working knowledge of Klaviyo, and you know how to pull audiences and segments from CRMs and other data platforms to power precise, high-converting sends.




This is a compliance-critical role. You're working with health and telehealth brands, so you understand the guardrails around messaging regulated products — consent, opt-in/opt-out management, TCPA/CASL, CAN-SPAM, and platform-specific health messaging policies. You know how to write and ship campaigns that convert without putting the client at risk.

Maintain audit-ready documentation of consent and subscriber management

Communicate performance drivers and learnings to account managers and leads

2–4 years of hands-on email/SMS or lifecycle marketing experience

description:
About the job

Enrollment Specialist - Inside Sales, Healthcare Financing




About United Credit




United Credit helps healthcare providers grow their practices by making patient financing simple.




Unlike single-lender financing companies, United Credit gives providers access to multiple financing options through one application, helping more patients get approved while allowing providers to offer financing that fits a wider range of credit profiles. Our merchant partners rely on us not just for financing, but for responsive service, industry expertise, and a true partnership focused on helping their businesses grow.




We’re a fast-moving, entrepreneurial company where ideas become action quickly. We value accountability, collaboration, and people who take ownership of their work. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and making a measurable impact every day, you’ll fit right in.




Position Summary




The Enrollment Specialist is responsible for generating new merchant enrollments by engaging healthcare providers, qualifying opportunities, guiding practices through the enrollment process, and creating a seamless onboarding experience. Reporting to the Sales Manager, this role serves as the first impression of United Credit and plays a critical role in growing our provider network. This is a high-activity, performance-driven inside sales role focused primarily on new enrollments, with a secondary responsibility of reactivating assigned accounts.




Essential Responsibilities




● Own the entire enrollment pipeline from initial outreach through underwriting approval.

● Work consumer-sourced leads where a patient has inquired about financing through United Credit but their provider is not yet enrolled: proactively contact the provider by phone and email, let them know a patient is actively seeking financing, and pitch enrollment in the United Credit platform.

● Make outbound calls daily and respond to inbound leads in a timely manner, maintaining high speed-to-lead standards since providers can choose a competitor within minutes.

● Focus on reaching decision-makers (owners, office managers, providers) and qualify opportunities through meaningful conversations that lead to next steps.

● Consistently overcome objections from providers currently using competitors such as Cherry, CareCredit, Proceed Finance, and HFD.

● Guide providers step-by-step through the enrollment process, including sending the digital enrollment link and clearly communicating required documents (driver’s license, proof of banking, 3 months of bank statements, and medical/business license).

● Ensure all documentation is accurate and complete, then submit applications and move accounts to underwriting for approval.

● Create urgency around provider onboarding to reduce enrollment cycle time.

● Set qualified appointments for Business Development Managers, confirm attendance, and position calls as valuable (training, growth, increased approvals).

● Complete 5-10 meaningful follow-ups daily on incomplete enrollments, missing documents, and no-response prospects, maintaining persistence without being pushy.

● Collaborate closely with Business Development Managers to ensure a seamless transition after activation.

● Contact assigned accounts to reintroduce United Credit, highlight program improvements, and encourage submission of new applications.

● Log all activity in Salesforce with detailed notes and next steps, and keep a clean, prioritized pipeline while managing multiple accounts simultaneously.

● Set and meet weekly and monthly enrollment and appointment targets, contributing to overall loan volume growth.

● Perform other duties as assigned.




Performance Metrics (KPIs)

● Calls: 50+ daily

● Talk Time: 2+ hours daily (live conversations only; voicemail/hold time does not count)

● Live Conversations: 8-12 per day

● Appointments Set: 2-4 daily, 10-20 per week

● Follow-Ups: 5-10 daily

● New merchant enrollments and enrollment cycle time

● Enrollment-to-activation conversion rate




What Success Looks Like

● You build trusted relationships with healthcare providers.

● You move quickly and follow through on commitments.

● You solve problems rather than waiting for direction.

● You use data to prioritize your day and keep your pipeline moving.

● You consistently meet or exceed activity and performance goals.

● You contribute ideas that improve the merchant experience.




Required Skills

● Strong phone presence with the ability to drive high call volume and meaningful talk time.

● Consultative, relationship-driven sales approach rather than a transactional one; comfort with solution selling.

● Excellent follow-up discipline and a sense of urgency, given how quickly providers can choose a competing financing option.

● Ability to manage and prioritize a multi-account sales pipeline independently.

● Comfort working in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with documentation.

● Coachable, consistent, and self-motivated, even on slow days.

● Healthcare sales, medical sales, or patient financing experience is a strong plus.




Work Location & Hours

● Fully remote position open to international candidates, with preference for Mexico-based candidates.

● Full-time.




United Credit is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of United Credit to provide all persons with equal employment and educational opportunities without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, gender, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, religion or similar factors as defined by law.

Rilith is empowering intelligent machines at scale. With teams spanning the USA, LATAM, EU, and Asia, we bring a truly global perspective to every project we undertake. title: Especialista en Performance Marketing y Estrategia Digital B2B
description:
About the job

🚀 En AddControl buscamos sumar a nuestro equipo una persona que lidere internamente nuestra estrategia de adquisición digital.

No buscamos únicamente a alguien que sepa configurar campañas. Buscamos un perfil autónomo, analítico y con visión de negocio, capaz de entender nuestro mercado, buyer persona, proceso comercial y objetivos de crecimiento para en que plataformas invertir, qué optimizar y qué nuevas oportunidades explorar.

🎯 ¿Qué harás?

• Crear, administrar y optimizar pauta en Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads y LinkedIn Ads.

• Analizar el desempeño de cada canal y tomar decisiones sobre inversión, segmentación, audiencias y formatos.

• Gestionar y optimizar presupuestos publicitarios con base en resultados comerciales.

• Diseñar y ejecutar pruebas A/B y experimentos de crecimiento.

• Analizar métricas como CPL, CAC, MQLs, SQLs, costo por oportunidad, conversiones y pipeline generado.

• Trabajar de la mano con el equipo comercial para evaluar la calidad de los leads y mejorar continuamente la estrategia.

• Identificar oportunidades, nuevos canales y acciones de generación de demanda.

🔎 ¿Qué perfil buscamos?

• 3+ años de experiencia en marketing digital, performance marketing o paid media.

• Experiencia comprobable operando campañas en Meta Ads y Google Ads.

• Experiencia con LinkedIn Ads y YouTube Ads.

• Dominio de uso de CRM (deseable Go High Level) y flujos de proceso dentro del CRM. 

• Capacidad para analizar datos y convertirlos en decisiones concretas de negocio.

• Conocimiento de funnels de adquisición, conversiones y procesos comerciales.

• Alta autonomía, pensamiento estratégico, proactividad y orientación a resultados.

• Capacidad para cuestionar la estrategia actual y proponer nuevas oportunidades sin esperar instrucciones constantes.

• Deseable experiencia en empresas B2B, SaaS, software, ERP o industria de la construcción. 

💡 Buscamos especialmente a alguien que pueda responder preguntas como:

• ¿Estamos invirtiendo en los canales correctos?

• ¿Qué campañas generan oportunidades comerciales reales y cuáles solo generan leads?

• ¿Dónde deberíamos aumentar o reducir presupuesto?

• ¿Qué nuevos experimentos deberíamos ejecutar durante los próximos 90 días?

💻 Modalidad: 100% remota.

💰 Esquema: prestación de servicios profesionales por honorarios.

💵 Honorarios mensuales: $20,000 a $30,000 MXN, de acuerdo con experiencia y conocimientos.

📈 Posibilidad de bono variable por cumplimiento de objetivos.

Si te interesa formar parte del equipo, envía tu CV a reclutamiento@addcontrol-erp.com con copia a cpacheco@addcontrol.com.mx, y de ser posible, algunos ejemplos de campañas, proyectos o resultados que hayas gestionado.
